content:
alex.k: Quick question on API contract for usage fields. We're seeing ambiguity on how cached tokens are reported for streaming responses and prefix cache matches. Current response example from prod: { "prompt_tokens": 120, "completion_tokens": 80, "cached_tokens": 40 } — accounting wants a single source of truth for billing (net chargeable units). How should we surface this without breaking existing clients? cc @maya-r @chris_w

maya-r: Product intent is simple: billing should reflect what the customer is charged (i.e., net tokens after cache). API must expose a single field that the billing system can use (e.g., "chargeable_units" or "billed_units"). Keep prompt/completion/cached fields for observability.

chris_w: Implementation question: streaming currently returns interim chunks and a final event. Do we compute cache attribution only at end-of-stream and emit the "chargeable_units" in the final response? Interim chunks can include diagnostics but should not be used for billing. Proposing: interim responses include prompt/completion/cached diagnostics; final response includes "chargeable_units" (aggregated). Thoughts?

samira: From accounting side we need deterministic rules for prefix cache. If a request prefix matches cached output for N tokens, those N tokens should be subtracted from prompt tokens for billing but preserved in diagnostics. Also need "cache_origin" hint (values: "prefix", "kv", "model") so ledger can filter.

alex.k: Proposed final response schema example (final event):
```
{
  "prompt_tokens": 120,
  "completion_tokens": 80,
  "cached_tokens": 40,
  "cache_origin": "prefix",
  "chargeable_units": 160  // prompt+completion - cached
}
```
(Is chargeable_units integer OK?)

chris_w: That looks fine. Implementation notes: publish numeric types as numbers (integers). For split attribution recommend flat fields instead of nested objects to avoid breaking clients. E.g., add "cached_prompt_tokens" and "cached_completion_tokens" rather than a nested "cached_split". Also keep legacy "cached_tokens" for now as a convenience field.

maya-r: Agree. Final contract: add fields: "cached_prompt_tokens", "cached_completion_tokens", "cache_origin", and "chargeable_units". Keep existing "cached_tokens" (sum) but mark deprecated. Backcompat: continue populating "cached_tokens" for 6 months after public announcement.

samira: For reconciliation: ledger should consume "chargeable_units" directly. We should log mapping rules in GH#4821 so any historical reprocessing has deterministic mapping. Also we need test vectors for prefix-edge cases.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Staging rollout scheduled: 2026-01-14T21:12:00Z for service/inference-api v2.3.1 — includes "chargeable_units" and split cached fields.

alex.k: :thumbsup: I'll open the API docs PR and the deprecation timeline. Action items: alex -> PR (docs + examples) PR#7890, chris -> streaming implementation + unit tests, samira -> billing mapping GH#4821.

samira: One quick policy edge-case: some clients asked for a "prefer_cached_charge=false" flag to force charging even if cache is used (for testing). Accounting thinks that's risky. Recommend we don't support opt-outs that affect billing.

maya-r: Product decision: do not allow client-side opt-out for caching billing. That will not be a request param.

chris_w: OK will ignore any "prefer_cached_charge" param and add validation returning 400 if set.

alex.k: Thanks all. I'll add unit test spec in the PR (include one prefix-cache example where prompt 50, completion 30, cached_prompt_tokens 20 => chargeable_units = 60). Ping eng-qa once PR is up.

samira: Example test vector for clarity: input prompt length 70, model emitted completion 30, cache matched first 20 prompt tokens and 10 of completion (rare), so fields should be: prompt_tokens=70, completion_tokens=30, cached_prompt_tokens=20, cached_completion_tokens=10, cached_tokens=30, chargeable_units=70+30-30=70.

alex.k: Perfect. Filing GH issue for test vectors + docs. GH refs: PR#7890, GH#4821. Thanks.
